body.name: Conormal endpoint-response handle
body.construction: The handle \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{resp}}\) begins with the explicitly normalized operator \(\mathscr L_f\), applies a conormal Green-function cancellation after flattening each supplied boundary chart, and sums dyadic Dini shells for the linear Hessian bound; it then differentiates the Monge--Ampere equation and its second boundary condition a second time to bound the nonlinear remainder in \(C^2(\Omega)\).
